embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:04efadc.description: Introducing Moonlake, AI for creating world simulations. ABOUT MOONLAKE Moonlake is building the frontier of interactive world models: systems that generate, simulate, and reason over 3D environments for embodied AI, robotics and gaming. We develop the simulation infrastructure to build worlds (e.g., assets, scenes, digital twins) at scale. Our team sits at the intersection of: - Embodied AI - Robotics simulation - Interactive 3D worlds - World models - Real-time generation - AI infrastructure Moonlake is building the next generation of AI infrastructure for interactive digital worlds. Our mission is to enable anyone to create, simulate, and interact with rich environments using natural language and multimodal inputs, turning simple ideas into worlds with structure, logic, and agents that can perceive and act. Our team has raised $28M in seed funding from NVIDIA Ventures, Threshold Ventures, AIX ventures and notable angels including Naval Ravikant and Jeff Dean to build the foundational layer for the future of AI - powering everything from creative tools and games to robotics training, simulations, and digital twins. Our goal is to make building and experimenting with these environments as accessible and scalable as publishing video on the internet. We are looking for exceptional research engineers and applied researchers to help push the frontier of interactive AI. with solid backend engineering judgment: you design sound database schemas and system architecture and understand the tradeoffs - Strong technical communication — you turn ambiguity into clear plans, explain tradeoffs to non-engineers, communicate with high signal, and drive alignment proactively - Sound product and UX judgment — you decide what's worth building TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE WE VALUE - React / Next.js / TypeScript, Tailwind / shadcn, and modern web application architecture - Building product features and UI/UX for agentic systems — where AI takes actions, reasons over state, and drives multi-step, long-horizon workflows with streaming UIs, generative UI, etc. - Building scalable backend services and APIs - AI-native product workflows BONUS POINTS (any one is a plus, none required) - Extensive experience building and shipping agent / LLM-powered product features - Founding / 0→1 engineer, or entrepreneurial experience - Physics AI / simulation and robotics stack — Isaac Sim, MuJoCo - 3D asset workflows (Blender) or other world-building / assets-building tools WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Moonlake is building tools that sit between: - AI systems and human creativity - Simulation and interaction - Research infrastructure and product experience The interface layer is critical. foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: About Founders Factory Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator backed by some of the world's leading corporations. We combine capital investment with deep operational expertise to build and scale tech companies from scratch. With a portfolio of over 300 companies and $900M+ in follow-on funding, we offer a unique opportunity to shape the future of tech and entrepreneurship - working at the intersection of corporate innovation and startup building. About the Role Venture Design at Founders Factory is how we create new venture concepts on demand, not by chance. Working closely with our corporate partners, you'll take high-level investment themes and turn them into validated, venture-backable concepts through a structured three-month sprint. This is the earliest and most exploratory stage of our venture building process. You'll dig into markets, uncover gaps, conceptualise solutions, and pressure-test them with real users - all before a founder is ever hired. The concepts you validate and present to our Investment Committee become the ventures we go on to build. It's high-impact, high-autonomy work that directly shapes our portfolio. What You'll Do You'll own the end-to-end venture design sprint, working across research, strategy, prototyping, and validation. Specifically, you will: - Take investment themes developed with our corporate partners and break them down into explorable problem spaces and opportunity areas. - Conduct deep market research to understand where sectors are heading, identify structural gaps, and map the competitive landscape. - Generate multiple potential venture concepts from each theme, applying human-centred design principles to conceptualise solutions that address real user needs. - Design and run rapid experiments — including A/B testing, prototype testing, and user interviews — to validate or kill concepts quickly. - Synthesise research and testing into clear, evidence-backed recommendations, narrowing from many ideas to a shortlist of the strongest concepts. - Present validated concepts to the Investment Committee (comprising decision-makers from our corporate backers and the Founders Factory CEO), making a compelling case for which ventures to greenlight. - Collaborate across the studio — working with other Venture Designers, Venture Builders, investors, and functional specialists — to sharpen your thinking and leverage collective expertise. - Stay close to emerging technologies, tools, and market shifts so you're always bringing fresh thinking to each sprint. What We're Looking For - Proven experience in 0→1 concept development, venture design, or similar roles where you've taken ideas from fuzzy opportunity spaces through to validated propositions — ideally across multiple industries or verticals. - Strong strategic thinking combined with a bias for action. You can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to run a scrappy experiment in the same afternoon. - Deep comfort with market research and competitive analysis. You know how to find signal in noise and develop a point of view on where a market is going. - Experience designing and running rapid experiments (A/B tests, landing page tests, concierge MVPs, user interviews) to validate assumptions with real users. - Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You'll need to present complex findings and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders with diverse backgrounds. - A curious, creative mind that also brings discipline — you generate lots of ideas but know how to prioritise ruthlessly based on evidence. - Comfort with ambiguity and pace. The sprint format means things move fast and the brief is often wide open. That excites you, not intimidates you.
